mathsearch-desc: Waxay isku xirtaa mashiinka [http://search.mathweb.org/about.html MathWeb Search].
math-wmc-attach-results-help: Mararka qaarkood hal hawlgal ayaa ka koobnaan kara natiijooyin aad u badan oo aan hal fayl lagu soo gelin karin. Xaaladdaas, soo-gelintu waa in loo kala qaybiyo dhowr fayl.
math-wmc-attach-results-label: Ku lifaaq natiijooyin dheeraad ah hawlgalka jira
math-wmc-download-intro: Halkan ka soo dejiso hawlgalladii aad hore u gudbisay. Faylku wuxuu ka kooban yahay oo keliya natiijooyinka saxda ah. Dhammaan natiijooyinka aan saxda ahayn waa laga saaray.
math-wmc-Introduction: Halkan ku soo geli gudbintaada ee Hawsha Raadinta Xisaabta Wikipedia ee NTCIR ee hadda socota:
math-wmc-SelectRunHelp: Sheeg magac gaar ah oo loogu talagalay gudbintaada, ama ku dul qor qabyo qoraal hore u jiray.
math-wmc-FileHelp: Soo geli natiijooyinkaaga oo ah liis darajooyin leh, oo ay kala soocaan hakadyo, kana kooban lammaaneyaasha (queryId,formulaId). Madaxa tiirka oo qaabkiisu yahay queryId,formulaId waa loo baahan yahay.
math-wmc-RunAdded: Waxaa lagu daray gudbinta "$1" oo leh Aqoonsi "$2".
math-wmc-RunAddExist: Gudbin la yiraahdo "$1" ayaa hore u jirtay, iyadoo leh Aqoonsi "$2".
math-wmc-Warnings: Sadarradan soo socda ee faylasha gelinta waa la iska indhatiray:
math-wmc-bad-header: Khalad: Madaxa tiirku waa inuu ahaadaa queryId,formulaId. Tiirar dheeraad ah lama oggola.
math-wmc-too-many-results: Sadarka $1: Sababta: natiijooyin aad u badan oo loogu talagalay $2. Darajada loo xisaabiyey qaacidooyinka "$3" waxay ahayd "$4". Tani waxay ka badan tahay tirada ugu badan ee gudbinta la oggol yahay ($wgMathWmcMaxResults=$5).
math-wmc-malformed-formula-reference: Sadarka $1: Tixraaca qaacidada "$2" kuma waafaqsana qaabka "$3".
math-wmc-wrong-formula-reference: Sadarka $1: Tixraaca qaacidada (dib-u-eegis "$2", qaacido "$3") waa mid aan sax ahayn.
math-wmc-wrong-query-reference: Sadarka $1: Tixraaca weydiinta "$2" waa mid aan sax ahayn.
math-wmc-display-formulae-label: Muuji qaab soo bandhigga qaacidooyinka la gudbiyey
math-wmc-display-formulae-help: Laguma talinayo faylasha gelinta ee waaweyn.
action-mathwmcsubmit: U gudbi natiijooyinka Hawsha Raadinta Xisaabta Wikipedia ee NTCIR
right-mathwmcsubmit: U gudbi natiijooyinka Hawsha Raadinta Xisaabta Wikipedia ee NTCIR
math-tex2nb-intro:
Qaabkan tijaabada ah wuxuu muujinayaa fikradda u beddelidda TeX una beddelidda Nidaamka Xisaabta Kombiyuutarka (CAS).

Barnaamijkan tijaabada ah wuxuu u beddelaa shaqooyinka LaTeX-ka si toos ah una dhiganta shaqooyinka CAS.

Shaqooyinka aan si toos ah u taageerin CAS waxaa lagu turjumi karaa iyadoo la adeegsanayo xirmada DRMF (oo wali lagu horumarinayo).
math-tex2nb-mathematica: ... waxaa loo turjumay wax soo saarka CAS-ka...
pidredirect: Dib u jeedinta Aqoonsiga Joogtada ah
importfrompid: Ka soo geli Aqoonsi Joogto ah
mathsearch-protected-entity-edit: $1 $2 waa la ilaaliyey sababtoo ah Aqoonsigiisu wuxuu ka hooseeyaa $3. Hay'adaha leh lambarro hoose waxaa halkan loogu hayaa nuqullo kayd ah oo laga soo min-guuriyey isha sare, si adeeggu u sii shaqeeyo marka Wikibase-ka isha sare aan la heli karin. Fadlan isbeddelkan ku samee isha sare ee $4.
wikibase-listdatatypes-contentmath-body: Goob xogeed toos ah oo loogu talagalay oraahyada xisaabeed, qaacidooyinka, isla'egyada iyo wixii la mid ah, kuwaas oo lagu muujiyey nooca LaTeX ee DRMF/DLMF.
